name: 34473 · Ocala, FL
findings: ZIP 34473 (Ocala) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34473 (Ocala) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
